semiconductor_relevance: High — JTEKT Thermo Systems specializes in advanced heat treatment equipment for semiconductor applications, particularly for AI and power semiconductor packages.
summary: JTEKT Thermo Systems provides advanced heat treatment equipment tailored for semiconductor manufacturing, including solutions for SiC power semiconductors and VCSELs. Their offerings include clean ovens and lamp annealing systems designed for high productivity and low oxygen processing environments.
